sources.title: FICO announces layoffs, management restructuring
sources.description: FICO, creator of the dominant mortgage credit score, plans to cut 15% of its workforce and restructure operations in fiscal year 2027.

sources.title: FICO cuts workforce by 15% as part of AI-driven restructuring
sources.description: Credit-scoring giant Fair Isaac, known as FICO, said on Tuesday it would ​trim about 15% of its workforce as part of a broader restructuring and AI integration, becoming the latest US company to ‌cut jobs as businesses automate tasks and redirect spending toward the technology.
